parties.respondent_defendant: Sri. Mahadevaiah (husband) - deceased, represented by LRs.

facts_of_case: Parties got married in 1988. Two children were born. Husband filed petition for divorce under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 on ground of cruelty. Trial court allowed the petition.

legal_principles.principle: In a case for divorce on the ground of cruelty, the conduct charged as cruelty is to be of such a character so as to cause in the mind of the petitioner a reasonable apprehension that it will be harmful or injurious for the petitioner to live with the respondent.

legal_principles.principle: Special instances of cruelty have to be pleaded in a petition seeking decree of divorce on the ground of cruelty.
